problem.title: Minimum ASCII Delete Sum for Two Strings
problem.problemStatement: Given two strings, determine the minimum sum of ASCII values of characters that must be deleted from the two strings to make them equal.
problem.input: • First line contains string A. • Second line contains string B.
problem.output: Print the minimum ASCII deletion sum.
